title: PRD-12 synthetic risk input syntax

professionalRef.description: required; authorized person/profile. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PROFESSIONAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

credentialRef.description: required; verified professional credential evidence/version. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

specialtyCode.description: required; carrier-mapped specialty <= 60. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: SPECIALTY_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

practiceLocations.description: required; 1–100 permitted practice addresses. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PRACTICE_LOCATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

procedureCodes.description: conditional; <= 100 declared contract categories. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PROCEDURE_DECLARATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

priorClaimDeclarationRef.description: conditional by plan; restricted declaration with source version. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: CLAIM_HISTORY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

limitOption.description: required; offered limit/aggregate basis code. Sensitivity: financial. Error: LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
